# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 659 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Assisterr AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/assisterr-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI lab that builds and deploys domain-specific small language models (SLMs) and AI agents for businesses, plus Agent Tokenization as a Service (ATaaS) for AI startups launching agents.
- [zero.xyz](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/zero-xyz.html) (added 2026-10-18): Lets AI agents discover, connect to and pay per call for thousands of APIs and services without API-key setup or separate sign-ups.
- [AgentKey](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agentkey.html) (added 2026-10-18): One MCP install that gives AI agents live web search, X, Reddit and YouTube data, web page reading and market and token-price data, all paid from a single monthly credit subscription.
- [Picsellia MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/picsellia-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-17): Official MCP server for Picsellia's computer vision MLOps platform, giving AI assistants access to datasets, experiments, models, deployments and monitoring.
- [Valossa Assistant MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/valossa-assistant-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): EU-based video AI MCP server that lets Claude and other agents upload and search videos and pull transcripts, visual scenes, soundbites and ready-made clips.
- [YRIKKA Text-to-Model](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/yrikka-text-to-model.html) (added 2026-10-17): YRIKKA's ORION workflow that turns a plain-language mission description and a few unlabeled images into generated training data, candidate models and an evaluated, selected vision model.
- [ImageSorcery MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/imagesorcery-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): Local MCP server that gives AI assistants object detection, OCR, cropping, background removal and drawing tools, running computer vision models on your own machine.
- [Bubbaloop](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/bubbaloop.html) (added 2026-10-17): Kornia's open-source single-binary agent runtime with an MCP server that orchestrates cameras, sensors and robots on Jetson, Raspberry Pi or Linux through chat.
- [Telekinesis Agentic Skill Library](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/telekinesis-agentic-skill-library.html) (added 2026-10-17): Python library of 250+ perception, vision and robotics skills plus a Physical AI agent that turns natural-language prompts into reviewable robot code.
- [EyePop.ai](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/eyepop-ai.html) (added 2026-10-17): SDK-first vision platform where you define what to detect and it builds detection, tracking, OCR and VLM pipelines, with a Video Agent and agent skills, deployable to cloud, edge or on-prem.
- [Groundlight](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/groundlight.html) (added 2026-10-17): Turns any camera into a vision sensor: you ask a yes/no question in plain English and Groundlight builds and tunes the model, backed by human review, with edge deployment.
- [VideoDB Director](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/videodb-director.html) (added 2026-10-17): Open-source framework of 20+ video agents that search, summarize, clip, edit and stream video from natural-language commands, built on VideoDB.
